_comment: Version-keyed toolchain index. Paths are relative to this file's dir (the toolchain root). The reconstruction pipeline resolves tools through toolchain.py:resolve(role, version) instead of hardcoding paths. 'present:false' entries are real gaps, never faked.
host_note: DOS-hosted tools (MSC 6.0a, MASM 5.1, LINK 5.20) run under DOSBox-X; Win32-hosted tools (MASM 6.13 ML, MSVC 2.0) run natively but are Phar-Lap/Win32 and not used for 16-bit NE codegen.

msc-6.0a.role: PRIMARY 16-bit NE codegen (matches shipped Win95 16-bit DLLs)

msvc-1.52c.note: C/C++ 8.00c (Phar Lap TNT). Newer codegen (MOV AX,DS/LEA) than shipped; used for functional builds, not byte-exact 16-bit.

masm-5.1.role: PRIMARY real-mode assembler for pinned data + runtime-_TEXT modules

masm-6.13.note: Win32 PE ML.EXE; unusable inside DOSBox — do NOT use for 16-bit targets.

5.20.role: matches ~8 shipped NE16 DLLs incl. LZEXPAND; does NOT hang

5.60.requires: DOSXNT.EXE (Phar Lap extender) alongside LINK.EXE or on PATH -- bundled in linkers/link-5.60/
5.60.validation: VALIDATED 2026-08-31: clean drop-in for MSC 6.0a objects (compiler bytes untouched; 5 LZEXPAND segs stay byte-identical, only far-call operands differ vs 5.20). Encodes internal far-call operands with the DIRECT TARGET OFFSET (confirmed matching shipped 5.60 gdi.exe), NOT 5.20's 0xFFFF chain convention.
5.60.role: matches the MAJORITY of shipped NE16 DLLs (~163 of 189); banner mislabels itself 5.40

5.10.gap: NOT extracted. LINK 5.10 shipped with MSC 6.0 (hangs on large inputs in DOSBox). Source: MSC 6.0 disks in archives/msc-6.0a-floppies or archives/*.iso. Extract before targeting a 5.10 DLL.

5.30.gap: NOT extracted; source in an SDK/archive.

win31-kit.role: PRIMARY Win3.1-SDK medium-model DLL runtime + imports (matches shipped seg11 CRT)

msvc-1.52c.note: alternate CRT vintage; not the shipped one.

nt31-win32-sdk.note: ships an LZEXPAND.DLL md5-identical to Win95 (1993 build); Win95-era import ground truth.

newfiles.note: C7.0 / MSVC 1.0 / MSVC 1.5 install media trees.

win31-sdk-iso.note: Win3.1 SDK ISO (source of LIBW/MDLLCEW/LIBENTRY -> libs/win31-kit).

import_ground_truth.note: The actual shipped modules the target DLLs load against; authoritative for import ordinal<->name resolution (see spec 10.3).

gaps: linker 5.10 not extracted (needed by ~4 NE16 DLLs)
linker 5.30 not extracted (needed by ~8 NE16 DLLs)
linker 5.50 not extracted (needed by ~4 NE16 DLLs)
